betaNote: v0.2.10: fixes the Cosmo Canyon break-scene not loading after the D1->D2 'want to save?' prompt. Root cause: the v0.2.9 layer was hand-stitched from two separate diffs (a BLACKBGB-only layer + a FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN-fix layer) to avoid rebuilding from scratch, and that stitching corrupted LOST2.DAT's internal section-size table (walkmesh/background/model_loader boundaries shifted) even though the file's overall size matched CSR D2. This layer was instead regenerated in one pass, diffing a single freshly-built work bin (all merges + verified BLACKBGB manual splice + SNOVA inject + FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN table fix, no hybrid stitching) straight against the CSR v0.14.2 base. Verified: LOST2 byte-identical to CSR D2 (correct 3996/13012/76-byte walkmesh/background/model_loader sections), BLACKBGB byte-identical to the verified manual splice, FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN decompress cleanly, and reapplying this layer onto the CSR base reproduces the work bin byte-for-byte. Not yet tested on real hardware or playtested past the break scene on DuckStation -- please playtest a full run. Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
